verified_facts.text: The resort is situated beachfront on Fiji's Coral Coast, with tropical gardens and coconut groves.
verified_facts.excerpt: Situated beachfront in the heart of Fiji’s authentic and adventure filled Coral Coast with lush tropical gardens and enveloped by coconut groves

verified_facts.text: The resort covers 40 acres on the Coral Coast of Viti Levu.
verified_facts.excerpt: OUTRIGGER Fiji Beach Resort is a deluxe 40-acre resort located on the Coral Coast of Viti Levu.

verified_facts.text: The resort is designed to be reminiscent of a traditional Fijian village, with landscaped tropical gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: Reminiscent of a traditional Fijian village, the resort's 40 acres are beautifully landscaped with lush, fragrant tropical gardens and infused with warm Fijian hospitality.

verified_facts.text: Accommodations range from contemporary rooms with garden and ocean views to traditional Fijian-style thatched plantation and beachfront bures.
verified_facts.excerpt: Newly renovated guest accommodations range from contemporary rooms with spectacular garden and ocean views to traditional Fijian-style thatched plantation and beachfront bures

verified_facts.text: Beachfront Bures are traditional Fijian bure bungalows right on the beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stay in our traditional Fijian bure bungalows, right on the beach.

verified_facts.text: Guests in Ocean View rooms, suites or bures are offered the Talai Butler Service.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests staying in Ocean View rooms, suites or bures are offered our unique and exclusive Talai Butler Service – a five-star butler service with a South Pacific twist.

verified_facts.text: The Plantation Pool Bure has a thatched roof and a private plunge pool, set within tropical gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: Step from your thatched-roof sanctuary into a private plunge pool where sunlight dances and calm surrounds you.

verified_facts.text: There is an adults pool with a swim-up pool bar and lap pool, and a family pool with whirlpool spas and a waterslide.
verified_facts.excerpt: adults pool with swim up pool bar & lap pool and family pool with whirlpool spas and 3–loop waterslide

verified_facts.text: Daily cultural activities include traditional storytelling, meke dance performances, fire walking and village tours.
verified_facts.excerpt: Daily cultural activities to immerse in the rich traditions of Fiji, including traditional storytelling, meke dance performances, fire walking, village tours and more

verified_facts.text: Guests can join the OUTRIGGER Zone coral planting program, which helps preserve the oceans.
verified_facts.excerpt: OUTRIGGER Zone coral planting program helping to preserve our oceans

verified_facts.text: The Coral Kids Club at the resort has dedicated staff to entertain children.
verified_facts.excerpt: With Coral Kids Club at OUTRIGGER Fiji Beach Resort and Castaway Kids Club at Castaway Island, you’ll find dedicated staff to keep your little ones entertained and engaged.

verified_facts.text: The OUTRIGGER Adventure Park offers a golf driving range, rock climbing, axe throwing and paintball.
verified_facts.excerpt: OUTRIGGER Adventure Park: golf driving range, rock climbing, axe throwing, paintball

verified_facts.text: Kalo Kalo Bar is a hilltop bar with Pacific Ocean views, serving cocktails, tapas, oysters and champagne at sunset.
verified_facts.excerpt: Feel like a star at this hilltop perch overlooking the resort. Sensational Pacific Ocean views and elegant service await.

verified_facts.text: Ivi Restaurant serves Pacific Continental cuisine next to a 100-year-old Ivi tree.
verified_facts.excerpt: Award-winning fine dining restaurant serving creative Pacific Continental cuisine. It’s all located adjacent to its namesake – a 100-year old Ivi tree.

verified_facts.text: The drive from the resort to the airport takes an hour and 10 minutes.
verified_facts.excerpt: It takes an hour and 10 minutes from the resort to the airport.

verified_facts.text: The resort is Green Key certified.
verified_facts.excerpt: Proud to be Green Key certified.

verified_facts.text: Complimentary beach activities include kayaking, paddleboarding and snorkeling gear.
verified_facts.excerpt: Choose from complimentary beach activities like kayaking, paddleboarding, snorkeling gear and more.

verified_facts.text: Guests are greeted with a Bula welcome song.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests are greeted by a “Bula!” welcome song which instantly immerses them into the warm island culture.
